title: Credit Control
description:
Consula is recruiting on behalf of a well-known engineering and building services contractor headquartered in Birmingham for an organised and confident Credit Controller.

Our client has built a strong reputation for reliable service and long-standing customer relationships, and as the business continues to grow, they are strengthening their finance team with a credit control specialist who can protect cash flow while keeping customers on side.

In this role, you will own a ledger serving construction, housing and commercial clients across the Midlands. You will be the friendly, persistent voice that keeps accounts up to date, resolving queries quickly and making sure payments arrive on time. Your work has a direct impact on the business's cash position, its customer relationships and the accuracy of month-end reporting.

The office is well connected to Birmingham New Street and the motorway network, with on-site parking and a modern, open-plan finance team space.

Location: Birmingham

Salary: £37,000 - £40,500 per year

Employment: Permanent

THE ROLE

As Credit Controller, you will manage the full collections cycle for your ledger, working closely with sales, customer service and the wider finance team.
- Managing a designated sales ledger, chasing overdue balances by telephone and email in a professional, solution-focused way.
- Prioritising collections activity using aged debt reports to reduce debtor days and keep overdue balances under control.
- Investigating and resolving invoice queries, disputes and pricing discrepancies with internal teams.
- Setting up and monitoring payment plans, and escalating persistent non-payment in line with credit policy.
- Allocating cash receipts and reconciling customer accounts accurately and promptly.
- Carrying out credit checks on new and existing customers and recommending appropriate credit limits.
- Placing accounts on stop where required and communicating clearly with account managers.
- Preparing weekly cash forecasts and aged debt reports for the Finance Manager.
- Supporting month-end close, audit requests and continuous improvement of the credit control process.

ABOUT YOU

Our client is keen to meet people who are calm under pressure, persuasive on the phone and meticulous with detail.

Essential:
- Proven experience in credit control, collections or accounts receivable.
- Confident, courteous telephone manner with the resilience to handle difficult conversations.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of accounts at once.
- Good working knowledge of Excel, including filters, lookups and pivot tables.
- High standards of accuracy when allocating cash and reconciling accounts.

Desirable:
- Experience of accounting systems such as Sage, Xero, SAP, Dynamics or similar.
- Understanding of credit checking tools and the debt recovery process.
- AAT or CICM qualification, or working towards one.

A TYPICAL DAY

You will start the morning by reviewing yesterday's receipts, allocating cash and checking which accounts are now due or overdue. Mid-morning is focused on your call list, speaking with customers, agreeing payment dates and logging every conversation. In the afternoon you will chase up outstanding queries with colleagues in sales and operations, review credit applications and update your aged debt report, finishing the day with a clear plan of priorities for tomorrow.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
- A secure, permanent role within an established and supportive Birmingham finance team.
- On-site parking and a modern, open-plan office.
- 28 days' annual leave including bank holidays.
- Workplace pension scheme with employer contributions.
- Study support towards AAT or CICM qualifications for the right person.
- Structured induction and clear progression routes within the finance function.
- A friendly team culture with regular recognition of good work.
- Health and wellbeing support, including an employee assistance programme.

If you are a determined, organised credit control professional looking for your next step, we would be delighted to hear from you. Apply through Consula today and Doug, our AI talent partner, will be in touch to discuss the role further.

title: Credit Controller
description:
An exceptional opportunity has arisen for a highly experienced, autonomous Credit Controller to assume ownership of a high-profile ledger within a leading, multi-site food production and manufacturing organisation based in Solihull. This is a fast-paced, high-volume environment designed for a seasoned professional who thrives under pressure, enjoys managing sophisticated corporate accounts, and possesses a natural flair for advanced query resolution.

Working as a trusted specialist within a friendly, high-performing finance function, you will take full accountability for a high-value portfolio of customer accounts to protect group cash flow and strategically reduce ageing debt. This dynamic role requires you to proactively chase outstanding balances via phone and email, accurately allocate complex, multi-currency incoming cash across the ledger, and perform detailed account reconciliations. You will frequently investigate and resolve intricate invoice and delivery disputes, partnering closely with internal commercial and distribution teams to dismantle payment barriers. Regularly analysing aged debt reports to flag financial risks and reporting key performance metrics to senior management will also form a critical part of your daily routine.

Skills Required
- Extensive background in credit control with a proven track record of managing large corporate ledgers.
- Advanced query resolution skills with the ability to navigate complex distribution and invoicing discrepancies.
- Exceptional negotiation and communication capabilities to manage high-value stakeholder relationships.
- Advanced technical literacy including strong Excel skills and proficiency in major ERP software.

What You Will Receive
- Highly competitive premium hourly rate with the financial security of guaranteed weekly pay.
- Premium exposure to massive, high-profile corporate financial ledgers that will significantly elevate your interim career profile.
- Highly collaborative team environment with a welcoming office culture and a comprehensive, fast-tracked on boarding process.
- Clear temp-to-perm progression pathway offering the opportunity to transition into a secure, long-term permanent position for the right candidate.

If you are a driven, career-minded Credit Controller looking for a high-impact, fast-moving role where your expertise will be recognised and rewarded from day one, we would love to hear from you, apply today and take the next step in your financial career.

title: Credit Controller

Good Excel skills and attention to detail.

If you're looking for a credit control opportunity offering hybrid working and ownership of your accounts, please apply with an up-to-date CV.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Job Title: Credit Controller
Contract: Temporary (approximately 4-6 months)
Start date: Immediate
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm
Location: Solihull (Hybrid Working Available)
Salary: £18 - £20 per hour, including holiday pay
Benefits: Hybrid working, free onsite parking, onsite restaurant and outstanding modern office facilities.

We are delighted to be working exclusively with a leading international organisation to recruit a Temporary Credit Controller to join their busy operational team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller to join a professional and welcoming working environment, taking responsibility for the proactive management and recovery of outstanding customer balances.

Working closely with customers and internal teams, you will play an important role in ensuring timely payment collection, resolving account queries and progressing outstanding balances, whilst maintaining positive and constructive customer relationships.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, commercially aware and confident taking ownership of their workload. You will need to be comfortable working independently, using your initiative and building effective relationships with a variety of stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
- Proactively contact customers regarding overdue balances, understanding payment issues and agreeing clear actions and timescales.
- Manage and prioritise outstanding accounts, considering the value, age and commercial importance of each case.
- Build and maintain positive customer relationships, handling payment queries and resolving issues professionally.
- Liaise with internal finance teams to reconcile accounts, investigate discrepancies and resolve outstanding queries.
- Work closely with colleagues across the business to progress disputes and overcome issues affecting payment.
- Monitor and progress outstanding balances, following up on queries and supporting information where required.
- Coordinate with external agencies where necessary to support the recovery process.
- Maintain accurate account records, document customer communications and provide regular updates on outstanding balances and recovery progress.

Skills and Experience Required
- Previous experience in a Credit Control or Accounts Receivable position is essential
- Confident managing customer accounts and chasing outstanding payments.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to handle payment queries professionally.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to prioritise a varied workload.
- A proactive, self-starting approach, with the confidence to work independently and use initiative.
- Good attention to detail and strong administration skills.

The Opportunity
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established international organisation offering an excellent working environment and a great team culture.

Based in outstanding modern offices, you'll benefit from hybrid working, free onsite parking, an onsite restaurant and excellent facilities.

The assignment is expected to last approximately 4-6 months, with an immediate start available.

Interested?
If you have previous credit control experience, are available at short notice and would enjoy taking ownership of this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!

For further information or to apply, please contact Tirebuck Recruitment, who are managing this vacancy exclusively.

If successful, one of our consultants will be in touch via phone or email for a confidential conversation about your experience, skills and suitability for the role. Please check your spam folder for any missed communication from us and ensure your contact details on your CV are up to date.
